cards.ex: There was a heated exchange between the manager and the employee about the project deadline.
cards.exUz: Menejer va xodim o'rtasida loyiha muddati haqida qizg'in bahs bo'lib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jiddiy va hissiyotga to'la bahs yoki tortishuv.

cards.ex: I tried to mediate the dispute between my neighbors, but they wouldn't listen.
cards.exUz: Men qo'shnilar o'rtasidagi nizoni hal qilishga harakat qildim, lekin ular eshitishmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nizoni hal qilish uchun uchinchi shaxs orqali yordam berish.

cards.ex: There was simmering resentment between the siblings due to their parents' favoritism.
cards.exUz: Ota-onalarning tarafkashligi tufayli aka-uka va opa-singillar o'rtasida yashirin g'azab bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri yashirinib kelayotgan norozilik hissi.

cards.ex: The budget was a major point of contention between the two departments.
cards.exUz: Byudjet ikki bo'lim o'rtasidagi asosiy tortishuv nuqtasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki tortishuvning asosiy sababi.

cards.ex: Threatening someone will only escalate the conflict.
cards.exUz: Kimnidir qo'rqitish faqat nizoni kuchaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Nizoni yanada jiddiy holatga olib kelish.

cards.ex: He tried to de-escalate the situation by speaking calmly.
cards.exUz: U vaziyatni xotirjam gapirib yumshatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada xavfsiz yoki tinch holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: It's important to seek common ground when negotiating a deal.
cards.exUz: Bitim tuzishda umumiy til topish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishish uchun umumiy nuqtalarni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I have a bone to pick with you about how you handled that project.
cards.exUz: Siz bilan loyihani qanday boshqarganingiz haqida gaplashadigan gapim bor.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir norozilik yoki shikoyat bildirish.

cards.ex: The company tried to paper over the cracks in its financial reports.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya moliyaviy hisobotlardagi muammolarni yashirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilmasdan, tashqi tomondan yaxshi ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni nazoratdan chiqmasdan oldin oldini olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: She gave me a point-blank refusal when I asked her for help.
cards.exUz: Men undan yordam so'raganimda u menga qat'iy rad javobini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday bahonasiz, qat'iy rad etish.

cards.ex: He wanted to settle the score after what they did to him.
cards.exUz: Ular unga qilganlaridan keyin hisobni tenglashtirmoqchi edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xato uchun qasos olmoq.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade, this plan isn't working.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni aytaylik, bu reja ishlamayapti.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni ochiq va to'g'ri aytish.

cards.ex: Don't fan the flames by arguing; just walk away.
cards.exUz: Bahslashib o'tga yog' sepmang, shunchaki ketib qoling.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki nizoni yanada yomonlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: That argument is water under the bridge now; let's move on.
cards.exUz: Bu bahs endi o'tib ketgan ish, keling, davom etamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va endi ahamiyatsiz bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I needed to get something off my chest, so I told her everything.
cards.exUz: Men dardimni aytishim kerak edi, shuning uchun unga hamma narsani aytdim.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini yoki tashvishlarini aytib yengillashmoq.

cards.ex: My philosophy is live and let live, as long as it doesn't hurt anyone.
cards.exUz: Mening falsafam - hech kimga zarar keltirmasa, yasha va yashat.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning fikrlari va xatti-harakatlariga toqatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I said some things in the heat of the moment that I regret.
cards.exUz: Men hissiyotlar ta'sirida afsuslangan narsalarni aytdim.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli hissiyotlar, ayniqsa g'azab paytida.

cards.ex: Sometimes it's best to turn the other cheek and ignore the insults.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan boshqa yuzni burib, haqoratlarga e'tibor bermaslik yaxshiroqdir.
cards.uzDef: Xafagarchilik yoki provokatsiyaga javob bermasdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: We need to bridge the gap between management and employees.
cards.exUz: Biz boshqaruv va xodimlar o'rtasidagi farqni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikni bartaraf etish, ikki guruh o'rtasidagi farqni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a war of attrition, with neither side willing to give in.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar charchatish urushiga aylandi, hech bir tomon yon bermoqchi emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Tomonlar charchagunicha davom etadigan nizo.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns and defended her idea.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z so'zida turdi va g'oyasini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z nuqtai nazaringizda qat'iy turmoq, fikringizdan qaytmaslik.

cards.ex: The children were caught in the crossfire of their parents' divorce.
cards.exUz: Bolalar ota-onalarining ajrashishi nizosining o'rtasida qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar o'rtasidagi nizo yoki bahsning qurboni bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I think his comments were totally out of line and inappropriate.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, uning izohlari butunlay chegaradan chiqdi va nomuvofiq edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinadigan yoki mos keladigan chegaradan chiqmoq.

cards.ex: We need to hold the company accountable for the environmental damage.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyani atrof-muhitga etkazilgan zarar uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlari uchun javob berishga majbur qilmoq.

cards.ex: The police can't turn a blind eye to such criminal activity.
cards.exUz: Politsiya bunday jinoiy faoliyatga ko'z yumib bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noqonuniy xatti-harakatni ataylab e'tiborsiz qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: I feel like I'm walking on eggshells around her since the argument.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan beri uning atrofida juda ehtiyot bo'lishga majburman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir xafa qilmaslik uchun juda ehtiyotkor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why this is happening.
cards.exUz: Nima uchun bu sodir bo'layotganining tubiga yetishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning asl sababini aniqlamoq.

cards.ex: If you need help, don't hesitate to reach out to me.
cards.exUz: Agar sizga yordam kerak bo'lsa, menga murojaat qilishdan tortinmang.
cards.uzDef: Yordam so'rash yoki aloqa o'rnatish maqsadida murojaat qilmoq.

cards.ex: They were both willing to meet each other halfway to resolve the dispute.
cards.exUz: Ular nizoning echimiga erishish uchun bir-birining talablaridan voz kechishga tayyor edilar.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishish uchun talablarning bir qismidan voz kechmoq.
